title: Ledger Entry
description: Hash-chained append-only journal entry bound to exact workorder and receipt digests

previous_hash.description: current_hash of the previous ledger entry (64 zero hex for genesis)

current_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical ledger entry excluding current_hash

workorder_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical workorder signing payload

receipt_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical receipt signing payload

token_burn.description: Token burn attributed to this ledger entry
